Definition
[Integral solution of a system of conservation laws] ↗ def:integral-solution-conservation-law 1. ch11:11.1-def-1\group Conservation Laws

An integral solution of (5) is a function $\mathbf u\in L^\infty (\mathbb R\times (0,\infty );\mathbb R^m)$ satisfying (13) for every test function (12).
